title: Graph neural networks versus feature-only learners for Chinese A-share sanction prediction: a holder–manager graph without transaction edges — reproducibility archive
description: Reproducibility companion to Graph neural networks versus feature-only learners for Chinese A-share sanction prediction: a holder–manager graph without transaction edges. Contains source, fixed-fit aggregates, source documentation, and tests for table regeneration. The reconstructed common-cutoff endpoint and graph semantics supersede the original release. Licensed source rows, company-level scores, row-level masks and natural-person identifiers are excluded. Synthetic interface checks are not a synthetic reconstruction of the empirical sample.
